integration-form.label: Local proof label
integration-form.summary: Validate a proof label and keep its trimmed text in a local worksheet card.
guidelines: Use the actual form Controller and forward its field ref so validation can focus the input.
Keep the label, help and error associated; describe a local result without implying a service save.
demonstrates: Required trimmed proof label, 3–32 characters, with the real React Hook Form validation gate.
Invalid submission focuses the input and associates its help/error; valid submission creates or updates a local proof-label card.
limits: The card is local React state and is lost when the example remounts; no record is sent or saved to a service.
checks: Submit empty and two-character labels; inspect focus and the associated errors.
Keep a valid label, edit it and submit again; verify the local card shows the exact latest trimmed text.

integration-combobox.label: Paper stock picker
integration-combobox.summary: Filter four original worksheet stocks and control the selected value, query and clear action.
guidelines: Keep selection and query as separate state; typing a query is not a committed selection.
Show the complete committed value outside a narrow editable field when useful.
demonstrates: Four fictional Argentine worksheet stocks filter locally by case-insensitive city or stock text.
Keyboard selection commits the actual full stock string; Clear returns selection to none and the field remains editable.
An unmatched query has a real empty state; Escape closes the popup.
limits: Labels and paper weights are illustrative worksheet options, not product listings or supplier affiliations.
Filtering and selection are local; remote search, ordering and persistence are not implemented.
checks: Filter recycled and choose the Córdoba stock with the keyboard; verify the complete selected value.
Clear the selection and query, search an unmatched term, then close with Escape and reopen the four choices.
